propositions: Eight Jira-specific root modules (acli.py, adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py, etc.) must be physically moved into adapters/jira/ as a single atomic change per ADR 0035.

The file-location loader must be taught relative subpaths for the three location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) to resolve them at their new adapters/jira/ location without breaking root-module loading.

All surviving dotted and sibling-path imports across modules (jira_fields.py:18, inbound_fields.py:36, acli_cli_ops.py:36, and lazy-load call sites) must be repointed to the new adapters.jira namespace in the same atomic change.

Test files in categories 2 and 3 (path constants and dotted imports referencing the moved modules) must be rewritten to reference adapters.jira paths, while category-1 patch.object sites remain unaffected.
After the move, grep for old root paths of relocated modules across src/ and tests/ must return zero hits (excluding path-agnostic _load_acli patches) and no re-export shim must exist.
Full test suite, loader integration tests, and module-size gate must pass with zero behavior changes, confirming a pure relocation and rebind.
